decision.explanation: Both Jan P. Syse and Jean-Marie Bosch are explicitly stated in separate documents (D1 and D2) to have served as the head of government of Serralongue. Document D1 states that Jan P. Syse held the position in the early 2000s, while Document D2 describes Jean-Marie Bosch as having served in the same role starting in the early 1980s. These are distinct individuals and distinct tenures, so both are valid answers to the question 'Who was the head of government of Serralongue?' without contradiction.
